name: WhatsApp Chat
description: A floating WhatsApp chat button with a preset message, left or right placement, your own colour and optional opening hours. Accessible, CSS-only animation, no third-party scripts.

panels.title: WhatsApp chat
panels.description: A round WhatsApp button in the corner of every page. It opens a chat with your number, with a message already typed.

fields.name: phone
fields.title: WhatsApp number
fields.description: In international format, such as +31 6 12345678. The button is hidden until you enter one.

fields.name: message
fields.title: Preset message
fields.description: Typed into the chat for the visitor; they can still change it. Leave it empty for a friendly default.

fields.name: label
fields.title: Label next to the button
fields.description: A short line such as "Chat with us". Leave it empty for a round button only.

fields.name: colour
fields.title: Button colour
fields.description: The icon turns dark or light by itself to stay readable.

fields.name: pulse
fields.title: Gentle pulse animation
fields.description: A soft ring that draws the eye. Always off for visitors who ask for reduced motion.

fields.name: hours
fields.title: Only show during opening hours
fields.description: Only show the button during the opening hours below, in your time zone. Visitors outside those hours see no button.

fields.name: timezone
fields.title: Time zone
fields.description: The zone your opening hours are in, such as Europe/Amsterdam.
